title: Juicy Canadian Beef Hash
description: A classic Canadian dish featuring crispy hash browns, tender beef, and a hint of dark rum. Perfect for a lazy Sunday breakfast or brunch.

ingredients.name: Beef
ingredients.notes: Choose a lean cut, such as sirloin or ribeye.

ingredients.name: Dark Rum
ingredients.notes: Optional, but adds a rich flavor.

instructions: Dice the beef into 1-inch cubes and season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the cooked beef back into the skillet and stir in the dark rum (if using).
Transfer the beef mixture to a large bowl and set aside.
Grate the potatoes and onions in a separate bowl.
Squeeze out excess moisture using cheesecloth or a clean dish towel.
Divide the grated potatoes and onions into 6 equal portions and shape each portion into a patty.
Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter in the same skillet over medium heat. Add 2 patties of the potato mixture and cook until golden brown and crispy, about 4-5 minutes per side.
Transfer the cooked patties to a plate and repeat with the remaining potato mixture.
In the same skillet, add the bacon slices and cook until crispy. Remove from heat and set aside.
Add the cooked beef mixture to the same skillet and stir in the beef broth.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until heated through, about 5 minutes.
To assemble the hash, place a cooked patty of potatoes on a plate, followed by a spoonful of the beef mixture, a fried egg, and a sprinkle of chopped chives (if using).
Garnish with additional chives and serve immediately.
